newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian IPSO-ILG to list in Brussels from June 27.
newsitem.headline: Belgian IPSO-ILG to list in Brussels from June 27.

text.p: Belgian industrial laundry equipment manufacturer IPSO-Industrial Laundry Group NV (ILG) said on Wednesday it expected to be listed on the Brussels bourse from June 27 after an initial public offering of 960,000 existing shares and 100,000 new ones.

It said the public offer would run from June 16 to 20 but could be closed early. The introduction price will be announced on June 14 after book-building with institutional investors in a private placement.
The company said the stake held by the current shareholders would drop below 50 percent following the bourse listing, which is lead managed by Generale Bank. Brokerage Petercam is co-lead manager.
ILG sells its washing machines, dryers and presses worldwide under the IPS, D-Hooge and Cissell brandnames.
IPSO-LIG said 200,000 of the offered existing shares were currently held by a 100 percent subsidiary.

It said in a statement that the capital structure and liquidity position of the group would be strengthened by the proceeds of the sale of these shares and the capital increase, which are aimed at financing further expansion.
The company said it had a consolidated net profit of 138 million francs in the financial year ending July 31, on turnover of 2.54 billion francs.
